question: Ruslan's approach (gene set -> mass -> promoter motifs per species -> regulators) repeated in mammalian fibroblasts
masses: nonbird_common_state_2026-10-21_v1/config/species_trait_admission.corrected.tsv, status admitted (Microtus 49 g; orangutan and dog excluded)
matrices: growth_regulators_2026-10-21_v1/inputs/<panel>_full.* (before gene filtering), per-species mean of samples
composition: single-symbol genes with positive expression in every admitted species of the panel; set score uses only these
primary_score: mean across set genes of per-gene z-score across species (log scale)
ruslan_style_score: log10 of summed linear expression over the same fixed genes
test: PGLS of score on log10 adult mass with the panel covariance; Pearson r reported as in Ruslan's figures
null: expression-matched random gene sets of the same size (deciles of mean log expression), two-sided |t|
multiple_testing: BH over all panel x set empirical p
replication_rule: same sign and empirical p < 0.05 in at least two panels
step2_regulators: per-species promoter motif enrichment for genes of replicated sets (native genomes), log odds ratio vs expression-matched background, PGLS on mass, BH over all motifs, replication across panels; frozen separately before step 2
